title: GET /rollcall/{id} returns 404: aiocoap Site routes by exact path
description: Discovered while fixing project-LICHEN-worker6-kxwt/q9gz. RollcallResource.render_get supports /rollcall/{id} via request.opt.uri_path[-1], but site.py registers the resource at ["rollcall"] and aiocoap's Site matches paths exactly, so /rollcall/r1 404s before render_get runs. Only root GET listing works. Verified empirically via InMemoryNetwork transport (POST 2.01, GET root 2.05 with entry, GET /r1 4.04). Fix likely needs prefix/wildcard handling or registering sub-resources.
